sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: very available and cheap. That is about the only practical argument it has. Use case can matter more than macros. If someone wants a sweet drink, the job is pleasure and context, not nutrition. Sometimes makes sense in a narrow use case. A small planned serving is different from making it the default drink.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Cons next: sweet format can stack up fast. Small-looking portions can still push the day away from the cleaner use case. Basically no useful nutrition. It gives up nutritional value while still costing calories. Easy to oversell beyond what the numbers support. Regular cola works as a treat, but the nutrition case is very thin.

closing.summary: Best bits are availability, cheapness, and a narrow treat role. Weak spots are sugar load, no fibre, no protein, no vitamins, no minerals, and the major downside context. Best as an occasional sweet drink, not a nutrition choice, because almost everything useful has to come from the rest of the meal.
